## RDS PostgreSQL

Creates an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL instance with a subnet group, a security group and a parameter group. Use it for relational, transactional data owned by a service.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance_class` | string | `db.t4g.micro` | RDS instance class. |
| `allocated_storage_gb` | number | `20` | Allocated storage in GB. |
| `engine_version` | string | `16` | PostgreSQL major engine version. |
| `multi_az` | boolean | `false` | Deploy a standby in a second availability zone. |
| `storage_encrypted` | boolean | `true` | Encrypt storage at rest with KMS. |

### Guardrails

- `storage_encrypted` must be `true`.
- In production, `multi_az` must be `true`.
- Confidential data requires encryption and no public access (`publicly_accessible` = `false`).
- Outside production, `allocated_storage_gb` may be at most 500.

inputs.name: multi_az
inputs.description: Deploy a standby in a second availability zone.

inputs.name: storage_encrypted
inputs.description: Encrypt storage at rest with KMS.

## S3 Bucket

Creates an Amazon S3 bucket with versioning, server-side encryption and a public access block. Use it for object storage such as files, exports and static assets.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bucket_name` | string | (required) | Bucket name (required). Must be prefixed with the service name. |
| `versioning` | boolean | `true` | Enable object versioning. |
| `block_public_access` | boolean | `true` | Block all public access to the bucket. |
| `encryption` | string | `aws:kms` | Server-side encryption algorithm (aws:kms or AES256). |

### Guardrails

- `block_public_access` must be `true` unless `data_sensitivity` is `public`.
- Confidential data requires KMS encryption (`encryption` = `aws:kms`) and `versioning` = `true`.
- `bucket_name` must be prefixed with the service name.

inputs.name: bucket_name
inputs.description: Bucket name (required). Must be prefixed with the service name.

inputs.name: block_public_access
inputs.description: Block all public access to the bucket.

properties.description:
## ElastiCache Redis

Creates an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster with a subnet group and a security group. Use it for caching and ephemeral data only.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node_type` | string | `cache.t4g.micro` | ElastiCache node type. |
| `num_cache_nodes` | number | `1` | Number of cache nodes. |
| `transit_encryption` | boolean | `true` | Enable in-transit (TLS) encryption. |

### Guardrails

- `transit_encryption` must be `true`.
- In production, `num_cache_nodes` must be at least 2.
- Not allowed for confidential data (cache only).

## SQS Queue

Creates an Amazon SQS queue, optionally FIFO, with an optional dead-letter queue and KMS encryption. Use it for asynchronous messaging between services.

### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fifo` | boolean | `false` | Create a FIFO queue. |
| `visibility_timeout_seconds` | number | `30` | Visibility timeout in seconds. |
| `dead_letter_queue` | boolean | `true` | Create and attach a dead-letter queue. |
| `kms_encryption` | boolean | `true` | Encrypt messages with KMS. |

### Guardrails

- In production, `dead_letter_queue` must be `true`.
- Confidential data requires `kms_encryption` = `true`.

inputs.name: dead_letter_queue
inputs.description: Create and attach a dead-letter queue.
